programme.title: Drain The Oceans 5
programme.desc: The story of one of the most precious lost treasures of the art world.At the beginning of the 18th century, Frederick I Hohenzollern ordered a master from Gdańsk to decorate one of the rooms in his Charlottenburg palace near Berlin with amber.In 1716, it was donated to Peter I. Later it went to St. Petersburg, and in 1755 Elizabeth I moved it to Tsarskoye Selo.In 1941 it fell to the Germans.Kept by the Nazis in a castle on the Baltic Sea coast, it suddenly disappeared in the last months of World War II.Researchers were given a new lead in this case by the recent discovery of a shipwreck carrying a secret cargo.It also recalled the largest maritime evacuation in history.
